import sys
from collections import deque

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    idx = 0
    q = int(data[idx]); idx += 1
    G = 0
    dq = deque()
    out = []
    for _ in range(q):
        t = data[idx]; idx += 1
        if t == '1':
            dq.append(G)
        elif t == '2':
            T = int(data[idx]); idx += 1
            G += T
        else:
            H = int(data[idx]); idx += 1
            thr = G - H
            cnt = 0
            while dq and dq[0] <= thr:
                dq.popleft()
                cnt += 1
            out.append(str(cnt))
    sys.stdout.write("\n".join(out) + ("\n" if out else ""))

main()

import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    idx = 0
    q = int(data[idx]); idx += 1
    X = 0
    plants = []
    head = 0
    out = []
    for _ in range(q):
        t = data[idx]; idx += 1
        if t == '1':
            plants.append(X)
        elif t == '2':
            T = int(data[idx]); idx += 1
            X += T
        else:
            H = int(data[idx]); idx += 1
            limit = X - H
            cnt = 0
            n = len(plants)
            while head < n and plants[head] <= limit:
                head += 1
                cnt += 1
            out.append(str(cnt))
    sys.stdout.write("\n".join(out) + "\n")
